title: Notion / Obsidian — What it is
description: Notion is an all-in-one workspace where everything is a block: pages, databases, kanban boards, calendars and docs compose from the same building pieces, and relational databases with rollups turn notes into working systems. Obsidian is a local-first Markdown knowledge base: every note is a plain .md file in a vault folder on your disk, linked with [[wikilinks]], visualized in a graph view, and extended with community plugins. Together they cover the two great philosophies of personal knowledge management: the cloud workspace and the offline vault. It is made by Notion Labs, Inc. / Dynalist Inc. and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux (Obsidian), Web, iOS, Android.
facts: Obsidian stores notes as plain Markdown files, so the vault remains readable without Obsidian itself.
